metadata.question: Was the number of fire detections in Pantanal, Brazil on June 11, 2024, greater than the number detected in any June from 2000 to 2023, as observed with MODIS Aqua?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use MODIS Aqua active fire detections (MCD14ML is FIRMS active fire points). But points are processed differently than images. In this case, I will load the MODIS Terra & Aqua Thermal Anomalies/Fire Daily L3 Global 1km product "MODIS/006/MOD14A1" (daily data over Aqua), yet note that MOD14A1 is Terra, and for Aqua I need MYD14A1. I can actually use the FIRMS dataset "FIRMS" (table/view) that includes both Terra and Aqua combined per year into one asset collection. However, the user is asking for Aqua detections only per day. The correct collection for daily fire pixels (Aqua) is: MODIS/006/FIRE/AVHRR/1KM or better to use GA/0002/MYD14A1 for Aqua Daily Fire product in 1km. Wait, check Earth Engine Data Catalog: I will use the FIRMS active fire "FIRMS" filtered to the MODIS instrument (Terra and Aqua) and to the source PLATFORM 'Aqua' if available. Alternatively use the MYD14A1 dataset: MODIS/006/MYD14A1: Aqua Daily Fire 1km. I will load MYD14A1 for Aqua detections. But this is a raster with fire mask. I need count of active fire pixels per day. For point-like events I can sum the FireMask==7 (high confidence fire) and ==8 (nominal) to get daily active fire pixel counts. 2. Ensure I look only at Aqua data. Using MYD14A1 dataset guarantees Aqua. 3. Geometry: Pantanal, Brazil. Use a representative polygon or bounding box. I will define a polygon around the Pantanal biome (approx area). 4. Time: June 11, 2024 vs every June day from 2000-2023. Normally "any June" means any single day in that period. I will compute the maximum June detection count for 2000-2023, then compare against June 11, 2024. 5. Masking: No clouds needed. Fire pixels are derived from thermal anomaly masking in the product itself. 6. Process: - Load MYD14A1 by dates. - Create a boolean image for FireMask==7 or 8 (fire). - Sum pixels in the region per day. - Collect daily counts for each June 2000-2023 and pick the maximum. - Compute same for June 11, 2024. - Compare. 7. Validation: - Check collection sizes. If zero for 2024 or all zero in the historical series, classify appropriately (C1 would be if no images at all, but unlikely). - If valid pixel counts are zero (C2), meaning all masked out due to no fire pixels, but still a valid count of 0. 8. Output: If 2024 value > max historical June value, return A: Yes, else B: No. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # Pantanal bounding box (approx) pantanal = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-59.2,-16.2],[-59.2,-21.3],[-54.7,-21.3],[-54.7,-16.2]] ]) def daily_fires(year, month, day_start, day_end): col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD14A1') \ .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(year, year, 'year')) \ .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(month, month, 'month')) \ .filterBounds(pantanal) if day_start is not None and day_end is not None: col = col.filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(day_start, day_end, 'day_of_month')) count_col = col.map(lambda img: img.select('FireMask').eq(ee.Image.constant(7)) \ .Or(img.select('FireMask').eq(8)) \ .selfMask() \ .gt(0) \ .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=pantanal, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9) .set('count', None).set('system:time_start', img.get('system:time_start')) ).filter(ee.Filter.notNull(['FireMask'])) counts = count_col.aggregate_array('FireMask').getInfo() return counts # June 2024 single day counts_2024 = daily_fires(2024, 6, 11, 11) if not counts_2024: print("No data for 2024.") print("C1") else: cnt_2024 = max(counts_2024) if counts_2024 else 0 # 2000-2023 June totals per day cnt_hist_max = 0 for y in range(2000, 2024): dd = daily_fires(y, 6, None, None) if dd: m = max(dd) if m > cnt_hist_max: cnt_hist_max = m if cnt_hist_max == 0 and cnt_2024 == 0: print("No valid pixels.") print("C2") else: print(f"2024-06-11 count: {cnt_2024}") print(f"Max count 2000-2023 June: {cnt_hist_max}") if cnt_2024 > cnt_hist_max: print("A") else: print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# Pantanal bounding box (approx)
pantanal = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[-59.2,-16.2],[-59.2,-21.3],[-54.7,-21.3],[-54.7,-16.2]]
])

def daily_fires(year, month, day_start, day_end):
    col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD14A1') \
            .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(year, year, 'year')) \
            .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(month, month, 'month')) \
            .filterBounds(pantanal)
    if day_start is not None and day_end is not None:
        col = col.filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(day_start, day_end, 'day_of_month'))
    
    count_col = col.map(lambda img:
        img.select('FireMask').eq(ee.Image.constant(7)) \
          .Or(img.select('FireMask').eq(8)) \
          .selfMask() \
          .gt(0) \
          .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
                        geometry=pantanal,
                        scale=1000,
                        maxPixels=1e9)
          .set('count', None).set('system:time_start', img.get('system:time_start'))
    ).filter(ee.Filter.notNull(['FireMask']))
    counts = count_col.aggregate_array('FireMask').getInfo()
    return counts

# June 2024 single day
counts_2024 = daily_fires(2024, 6, 11, 11)
if not counts_2024:
    print("No data for 2024.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    cnt_2024 = max(counts_2024) if counts_2024 else 0

# 2000-2023 June totals per day
cnt_hist_max = 0
for y in range(2000, 2024):
    dd = daily_fires(y, 6, None, None)
    if dd:
        m = max(dd)
        if m > cnt_hist_max:
            cnt_hist_max = m

if cnt_hist_max == 0 and cnt_2024 == 0:
    print("No valid pixels.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
else:
    print(f"2024-06-11 count: {cnt_2024}")
    print(f"Max count 2000-2023 June: {cnt_hist_max}")
    if cnt_2024 > cnt_hist_max:
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
